component.name: Secure Vault Manager
component.summary: Enterprise-grade zero-knowledge local password and credential manager

description.p: Secure Vault Manager is a high-performance, private, and secure credential vault. Powered by Qt 6 and a zero-knowledge Rust Core cryptographic engine (ChaCha20-Poly1305, Argon2id, PBKDF2), it keeps your passwords, passkeys, SSH keys, cards, and sensitive notes safely encrypted on your local device.

ul.li: Zero-knowledge local architecture with master passphrase & emergency recovery keys.
FIDO2 WebAuthn Passkey support with seamless browser extension synchronization.
Integrated RFC 6238 TOTP two-factor authenticator token generator.
Built-in OpenSSH agent forwarding via local Unix domain socket.
Biometric quick unlock (Touch ID, Windows Hello, Linux PAM).

description.p: Initial release with zero-knowledge Rust core, Qt6 desktop UI, and WebAuthn passkey engine.
